notes.title: FNAF:SOTM - PATCH #1 (1.004) NOW LIVE!
notes.content: [h2]Highlights & Changes[/h2][list][*][p]FNAF:SOTM has officially released in Asian regions![/p][list][*][p]Additional languages (Chinese-Simplified, Chinese-Traditional, Japanese, and Korean) are now available![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Additional FPS options (120, 144, 165, 240, and Unlimited) are now available![/p][list][*][p]Conduit Puzzles are now de-coupled from FPS[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added “Time Worked” to Profile Select Menu, tracking player’s time played on that specific profile[/p][/*][*][p]Added tutorial cards for Data Diver port’s first interaction for either mailbox outside or the Data Diver door in Welcome Show[/p][/*][*][p]Added various autosave checkpoints after lowering the Springlock Head in Workshops, in Admin Wing’s kitchen, returning back to Warehouse and Workshops later, returning back to Manager’s Lobby, and Retail Showroom when reading the mail[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to skip/end credits and intro sequence early[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed various texture issues from licensed asset packs[/p][/*][*][p]Added security camera assets wherever the monitors showed[/p][/*][*][p]Globally changed the icon above the Data Diver port on the Inventory Station to the first Permissions icon for gameplay clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Added a “Minimum Score” sign to Dead Eye Roxy’s Shooting Gallery[/p][/*][*][p]Updated credits for all endings[/p][/*][*][p]Updated and added various text, images, and SFX in MOON.EXE[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the score to win for all Shooting Galleries[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented refined animation and SFX for placing missing conduit puzzle pieces into their slots[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted conveyance for empty mailboxes[/p][/*][*][p]Haptics are defaulted to being on[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Potentially fixed an issue where the autosave icon can stay on screen indefinitely, blocking future autosaves from triggering[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a blocking issue where an infinite loading screen would occur when the player moves around while selecting 'Continue' in the Game Over screen[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented CC style caption for SFXs like (Radio distortion)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the title could freeze if the player paused at the game exactly as they are jump scared[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation issue where Arnold can drop items without holding anything causing his hand to perform wacky animations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sprinting long distances and then opening an airlock without stopping would cause the camera to bob up and down[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Welcome Show, Storage Area, Manager Lobby, Showroom Lobby, Rooftop, Big Top Chase, Nurse Dollie Chase, and Admin Wing performance/optimization[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation issue where items held in player’s right hand can appear ontop of it when approaching/interacting with buttons quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could cancel the Data Diver upgrade after beating the upgrade minigame[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various small places in the Storage Area where the player could use to hide from the enemy AI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an environment issue where items placed on the couch in the Security Office would appear to float[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an various environmental clipping issues in Power Room, Doll Hospital, Inventor’s Tunnel[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various cube map texture issues in Manager Office, Warehouse, Jackie’s Chase sequence, and Retail Showroom[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI navmesh and behavior in the Welcome Lobby, Manager’s Lobby secret storage room, Workshop Assembly room, Admin Wing, Night Light Maze, R&D, Mimic’s chase sequence[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted various ambient audio in Dollie’s chase sequence, Workshop, Warehouse, Power Zone, Retail Showroom, Showroom Storage, Admin Basement, Garage Exit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the reticle could temporarily disappear when dying while performing an interaction at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could be pushed on top of the lockers when exiting and backing up against it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dying while leaning in a locker causes the player’s default position to shift entirely[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with AI clipping through lockers[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted visual popping for some characters' animations when alert-to-search and chase-to-search behaviors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a gameplay/animation issue where their hand could remain raised upon reload after getting jump scared[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player was granted telekinetic powers when interacting an object while backing away, canceling, or just before they actually grab onto it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a gameplay issue where the player could use the ball gun to jump[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could avoid AI detection by stutter stepping[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation issue where the mouse toy would disappear in the player’s hand if wound up prior to approaching an interactable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation issue with Arnold’s arms when interacting with the Vacuum Bot[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation issue where the Data Diver cord could fly around when transitioning between airlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where all collectibles had a squeak sound effect when picked up/dropped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where all advertisement film reels reappear in the cabinets after reloading a save or leading/returning to the area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing up or down on the gamepad during various Menu pop-ups causes the player to unable to select yes or no[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted and implemented various “wake” and “inspect suit” animations for certain suited characters[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented new SFX for various sections in the game such as:[/p][list][*][p]Van running[/p][/*][*][p]Broken Data Diver door ports, using an airlock/Data Diver doors without the proper permissions, placing the Data Diver into the Inventory Machine[/p][/*][*][p]Dropping/picking up conduit puzzle pieces, missing conduit puzzle slots[/p][/*][*][p]Petting the Vacuum Bots[/p][/*][*][p]Dying from environmental deaths[/p][/*][*][p]Dollie getting hit from boxes and when she’s close to getting submerged, Party Time Chica breaking out of her box, Helpful in the Inventor’s Tunnel, moving Animatronics in one of the credits[/p][/*][*][p]Puppet Show targets, Workshop test stage machinery[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player can access and listen to higher security level audio on Helpful Kiosks when turning the Data Diver quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Polished the conduit puzzle interaction animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Data Diver animation after opening the Airlock is missing a few frames[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue for Assembly Room Dispatch VO to play over the PA System[/p][/*][*][p]Increased attenuation of the Security Office Dispatch VO lines[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an UI issue where selecting “Default” did not actually reset the language back to English[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Data Diver animation when interacting with airlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could exit the Springlock suit in front of a wall and sometimes fall off the world in R&D, Theater Backstage, Workshop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where changing the key bind to “Leave Springlock” did not work[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Setting “Invert Y-Axis” does not take effect in the New Game intro[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could scroll past valid list items on the “Gameplay” and “Controls” Options screen, potentially losing their cursor[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing ‘Default’ on Look Sensitivity will not save/apply the option[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could pause during loading screen transitions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a global audio issue where sounds could be heard during loading screen transitions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could still interact with the Data Diver door port to the Manager’s Office despite Jackie’s box covering it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a localization issue where signs in the Main Hallway were translated when they were not supposed to be[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various unlocalized tutorialization prompts when interacting with the Data Diver[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Arnold’s arms were visible after getting jump scared upon exiting a locker[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lighting on Star Orphans[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lighting around the film reel cabinets[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Conduit Puzzle pieces' models[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player was able to interact with filled puzzle pieces during the conduit puzzle filling up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the conduit puzzles immediately fail if the flow reaches a piece the player is moving even if the path is already complete[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lighting issue where the Springlock Suit was constantly flickering when worn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a global issue where collectibles withdrawn and left in the Inventory Machine de-spawn and can no longer be withdrawn or collected again until reload[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lighting issue where the van’s lights were visibly coming through the wall in Storage Area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where the ambient SFX could cut off when entering various airlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an AI issue where the patrolling AI would not re-spawn when reloading the checkpoint after dying[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Invert Y-Axis had no effect when using Mouse & Keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted baked shadows in the Showroom Storage Secret Area[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Mr. and Mrs. Helpful’s animations during kiosk interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there is an extra map objective in Showrooms 3 for the Manager office objective[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various small places and collision in Workshop and Mimic’s chase sequence where the player could use to hide from the enemy AIs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Dispatch subtitles will appear every time the player walks from the Welcome Show hall to the Storage Area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where reticles would appear and stay on-screen while using any terminal/station[/p][/*][*][p]Players are now able to throw the distractable toy mouse further[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there were missing Data Diver and Door SFX on the stairwell to the rooftop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there was no SFX for when the animation to raise the Data Diver for an interactable was used[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the generator revving mechanic was slower with a controller compared to using the mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where spamming <X> while the ‘Continue’ menu is loading results in a missing cursor, forcing the player to relaunch the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck on a loading screen after backing out of a profile and immediately mashing multiple options in the main menu[/p][/*][/list][h3]Act 1[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted animation for van’s speedometer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an subtitle issue with Dispatch’s lines in the intro cinematic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a localization/UI issue where one of Arnold’s subtitles during the intro sequence would go off screen because it was too long in French[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the intro and title card music cuts off abruptly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the van was driving through a cement block in the parking lot during the intro[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could see Arnold’s arms floating if the camera moved immediately after collecting the Data Diver[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed the backwards art/text on the wood panels in the playground[/p][/*][*][p]Turned off the lights/emissives on the lift in the Welcome Show in ACT 1[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted LOS for Elephant Mascot so players are able to see it more clearly after solving the Power Room conduit puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where overhead paging (PA System) for the Dispatch was working prior the power turning back on[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a gameplay issue where the Elephant husk could still be present when reloading the save in the Security Office[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue specifically for min-spec PC where the Main Hallway unloads when the player opens the door from Storage Area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Manager’s Hallway elevator lights would turn back on despite being inaccessible[/p][/*][*][p]Increased quality of the Manager Lobby cube map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could climb the couch on the Manager Lobby office and get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where the ambient SFX would stop in the back zone of the Manager Hallway Security Office[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where there was no ambient SFX in the back vent and entrance halls of Manager’s Lobby secret storage room[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could drop the Jackie crank on the bricks in front of the crank sock, unable to pick it back up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Digityper’s subtitles would continue to loop when entering the Manager’s Hallway and exiting shortly after[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock issue where the player could get stuck in the air when using the Manager’s Office generator as they come off the ramp[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Jackie’s jump scare being too dark in the Manager’s Office[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Jackie’s animation to track the player better when heading towards the hole in Manager’s office[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where various railings in Jackie’s chase sequence did not break[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in the Jackie Showroom by walking over some collisions near the yellow dog cutout[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the cube map of the storage area being mirrored while in the Jackie Chase vents[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Jackie could appear twice at the end of the catwalks section if the player crosses the next trigger point and quickly doubles backs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various audio issues during Jackie’s chase sequence where certain background audio can interrupt key moments[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where Jackie’s chase sequence music would not reset after an environmental death[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation issue where Jackie’s head was clipping through railings during her chase sequence[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Jackie’s jump scare model clips in geometry when caught in and around the elevator lift[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dying in a specific spot of the Jackie’s chase sequence would take the player to the game over screen twice[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Jackie’s box was gone and Digityper was alive… again if the player went back to the Manager’s Office later[/p][/*][/list][h3]Act 2.1[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where Mr. and Mrs. Helpful’s VO is very quiet if the player remained on the catwalks during the Welcome Show reset[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted timing of the Welcome Show stairs coming out as the same time as the first show[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck crouching next to the Welcome Show prize box[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could drop the elevator repair instructions tape underneath a locker and become unable to retrieve it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a gameplay issue where the ON/OFF slider for the Welcome Lobby Elevator Repair would go back to being ON after reloading[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the “Close/Open hatch” can only be read up close when the visual quality is set to LOW[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various audio/gameplay involving Welcome Lobby’s elevator repair section[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player can get stuck when standing to the left of the Welcome Show elevator doors as it was going up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the security gate lever in Manager Lobby Storage held the player’s camera for longer than over levers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where the Welcome Lobby elevator power slider was lacking SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the load balancing slider interaction speed would differ per repair[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the top of the Welcome Lobby elevator LOD appeared black[/p][/*][*][p]Improved optimization in Big Top Showroom where CPU usage would remain very high throughout[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted animation and visual popping with Big Top when he’s in his showroom[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where some of Mr. Helpful’s dialogue would play twice and repeat in Big Top showroom entrance[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lighting in Big Top’s Showroom[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various small places where the player could get stuck environmental assets in the Big Top Showroom and Showroom Lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Big Top ticket can be lost when dropped on the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where Mr. Helpful is still talking after the power goes out between each minigame[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could get soft locked if the player only knocks out the teeth in the first round and then goes through the vent[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the mini-game doors in Big Top showroom will not open after wining the mini-game a second time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where the Big Top’s jingle could play at a very low volume after solving the conduit puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Big Top could sometimes pick up a mannequin on his hand when crawling towards the entrance or retracting back into the showroom[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Big Top’s eyes stopped changing color when dying or reloading the save[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where layers could see the showroom lobby and halls unload when they’re on the Big Top showroom balcony[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in-between two airlock doors for Welcome Lobby → Retail Showroom, and Big Top Showroom → Rooftop Access[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Big Top Showroom conduit puzzle’s lever would appear in a down position when returning from Storytime Showroom[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where nothing would happen until moving forward a few steps when reloading at the top of the stairwell before Big Top’s chase[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various audio issues where Big Top’s chase sequence music would not trigger or reset properly after dying and retrying[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the first office area of Big Top’s chase sequence can be seen unloading when viewed from the plenum section[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there was a second Big Top visible behind the one descending towards the player right before the end of Big Top’s chase sequence[/p][/*][/list][h3]Act 2.2a[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Warehouse appears uninvited on the terminal maps despite being within the area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Mrs. Helpful kiosk subtitle in Workshops Test Stage was incorrect[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where AI could kick Springlock suit pieces and cause them to fling across the environment[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Springlock suit pieces were difficult to grab when dropped near lockers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a texture issue with hanged skinless Mushroom mascots[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted volume for the Jester suit’s jump scare for being too loud[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed ambient audio issues in the Test Control room of Workshops[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Captain springlock suit could be duplicated when bringing them over to the airlock[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the crane could pass through the collectible box on the Backstage Theater catwalks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Arnold’s arms would be displaced and unnaturally stretched when interacting with the crane controls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player was unable to see the Backstage Theater bridge animation when interacting with one of the cranks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Captain springlock suit’s cannon arm could clip through the environment when in position for the puppet show[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players were able to jump off the Backstage Theater catwalks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the players could get stuck in the Workshop automatic doors after exiting a Springlock Suit in the Test Stage area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue invisible collision that would appear in the middle of the collapsed catwalk bridge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation issue where the mouse distractable can be seen floating in the air while exiting a Springlock Suit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where most of the Theater Employee Hall was missing ambient SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an environment issue where the Theater stage can be seen as still clean and pristine when returning to the Backstage Theater catwalks after the Puppet Show[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a gameplay issue where the AI could be seen spawning in or on top of the player when walking over to the Theater side rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Puppet Show “ON AIR” signage would appear black[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted animation and visual popping for some characters and assets in the Puppet Show[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where shooting the broadcast target prior to the VO’s instructions still played the instructions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Jackie’s, Puppet Show puppets', and Mimic’s jump scares having a black background[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there are white box texture on the ceiling of the Puppet Show[/p][/*][/list][h3]Act 2.2b[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an animation/environmental issue of gates snapping into position in the Doll Hospital[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where the Doll Hospital BGM would be missing after a retry or reload[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various LOD lighting and texture issues in the Doll Hospital and Dollie’s chase sequence[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an gameplay issue where control input to exit the Springlock suit specifically in Doll Hospital was inconsistent with exiting the Springlock suit elsewhere[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio issue where Nurse Dollie’s jump scare audio was missing if triggered immediately upon her spawn in the Doll Hospital[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the trash compactor lights still appeared green being in an inactive state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing the interact button while holding a trash cube plays a throwing animation[/p][/*][*][p]Polished the trash cube depositing animation[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Doll Hospital siren sound and light from the trash cute control machine to stop after the Conveyor encounter with Nurse Dollie[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an environment issue where Molten Dollie would already appear in the security footage in the Surveillance Room despite not yet being thrown into the randomly start playing, overlapping, etc. if dying at various points of the chase prior[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Molten Dollie could be seen visibly spawning during the Dollie’s chase on the Dollie Chase conveyor belt when walking against other collisions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could hide behind a tool chest and become trapped by Molten Dollie in the second could exit the Doll Hospital elevator early[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player can get stuck after climbing across the terminal of Doll Hospital[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the muffling sounds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Act 2.3[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Warehouse airlock could appear closed on the Main Hallway side[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the “We Have a Winner” achievement would not trigger if the Warehouse’s Ball Toss minigame was the last game won[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Party Time Chica could de-spawn in Warehouse if the player crouches notes.title: Hot Fix 1 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2] Read Me First  [/h2][list][*][p]⚠️Please read these patch notes with caution [b]as THERE ARE SPOILERS[/b]! If you wish to read the more generalized/less-spoilery version, you can read our previous post to the community → [url="https://www.steelwoolstudios.com/announcements/upcominghotfix1"]https://www.steelwoolstudios.com/announcements/upcominghotfix1[/url][/p][/*][*][p]⚠️ Please make sure that you meet the [b]minimum spec requirements for PC (Steam/EGS) [/b]AND[b] that you have your graphics card drivers updated[/b]! A lot of min-spec & higher spec players have been able to resolve their at-launch crashes after updating their graphics card drivers & Windows. For further clarification, if you have:[/p][list][*][p][b]An NVIDIA graphics card[/b], you should have the NVIDIA “[url="https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/software/nvidia-app/"]GeForce Experience[/url]” app installed with the latest available “GeForce Game Ready Driver” on the DRIVERS tab.[/p][/*][*][p][b]An AMD graphics card[/b], you should have the “[url="https://www.amd.com/en/support/download/drivers.html"]AMD App[/url]” installed as it will auto-detect and follow along their instructions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]⚠️ We did put in a fix for the Welcome Show doors never opening for some players. It may still take around 5 mins for players who are UNDER the minimum PC specs(and/or PC hardware is not fully updated - see above). [b]Please note that your experience further in the game will not meet expectations if you fall under the minimum requirement[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added emissive elements to trash cubes for improved clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]The outer gates of R&D can no longer be back-tracked after 0% power.[/p][/*][*][p]The basement door to Inventor’s House can no longer be back-tracked.[/p][list][*][p]This addresses the bug where Mimic could fall through the second floor of the Inventor’s House.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mimic can now be heard LOUD AND CLEAR throughout the entire chase.[/p][/*][*][p]Mimic’s eyes are now brighter during the chase.[/p][/*][*][p]Mimic’s footsteps are now heavier during the chase.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed various crashes that occur when launching the game on Steam or Epic game Store.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Welcome Show doors would not open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck suspended in the air if they crouch on the ramp and grab the generator in Manager’s Office.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a hard blocking issue in R&D where players could fall out of the world on reload if they crouched after placing the final springlock suit down.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a hard blocking issue in R&D where players would be stuck in either hallway if they moved the Monty or Bub springlock suits last.[/p][list][*][p] 🙏 Players who have encountered this [i]specific[/i] issue should be able to reload back into their saves and progress towards the R&D Security Office as intended now![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a hard blocking issue in R&D that allowed the player to enter springlock Suits through the gates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Big Top Showroom where the player could fall through the world when reloading the checkpoint in the prize wheel room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could get softlocked when going behind the ball toss machines. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that causes the player to get stuck on the EULA or WARNING screen when trying to skip the splash screen immediately after the game launches.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Chica would de-spawn from the Warehouse if the player crouches and then enters lockers. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players can run around Mimic after he breaks through the security door allowing them see him break it again and lose all their controls after dying[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Mimic’s voicelines would overlap F10-N4’s dialogue in the R&D Security Office.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Mimic’s voicelines would sometimes not play during the chase.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Mimic would not spawn in until surpassing a trigger if the player reloaded the checkpoint at the top of the Basement stairs of the Inventor’s House.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Mimic could spawn in inactive in the Inventor’s House.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Mimic would not spawn in if the player inserted a tape in the Inventor’s House and then reloaded the autosave.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added emissive elements to trash cubes for improved clarity.

tags.bug: This addresses the bug where Mimic could fall through the second floor of the Inventor’s House.
Fixed various crashes that occur when launching the game on Steam or Epic game Store.
Fixed an issue where the Welcome Show doors would not open.
Fixed an issue where players could get stuck suspended in the air if they crouch on the ramp and grab the generator in Manager’s Office.
Fixed a hard blocking issue in R&D where players could fall out of the world on reload if they crouched after placing the final springlock suit down.
Fixed a hard blocking issue in R&D where players would be stuck in either hallway if they moved the Monty or Bub springlock suits last.
Fixed a hard blocking issue in R&D that allowed the player to enter springlock Suits through the gates.
Fixed an issue in Big Top Showroom where the player could fall through the world when reloading the checkpoint in the prize wheel room.
Fixed an issue where players could get softlocked when going behind the ball toss machines.
Fixed an issue that causes the player to get stuck on the EULA or WARNING screen when trying to skip the splash screen immediately after the game launches.
Fixed an issue where Chica would de-spawn from the Warehouse if the player crouches and then enters lockers.
Fixed an issue where players can run around Mimic after he breaks through the security door allowing them see him break it again and lose all their controls after dying
Fixed an issue where Mimic’s voicelines would overlap F10-N4’s dialogue in the R&D Security Office.
Fixed an issue where Mimic’s voicelines would sometimes not play during the chase.
Fixed an issue where Mimic would not spawn in until surpassing a trigger if the player reloaded the checkpoint at the top of the Basement stairs of the Inventor’s House.
Fixed an issue where Mimic could spawn in inactive in the Inventor’s House.
Fixed an issue where Mimic would not spawn in if the player inserted a tape in the Inventor’s House and then reloaded the autosave.

notes.title: Details on the Upcoming Hot Fix Patch 1
notes.content: [p]Hello friends,[/p][p]Thank you all, again, for supporting us during our launch![/p][p]We are hard at work investigating and fixing issues folks have been reporting. In light of that, [b]we wanted to provide you all insight into where we're putting our efforts so you know what you can expect from our first game patch. Here's what we're focusing on right now:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixing the automatic entryway doors not opening at the beginning of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing a soft lock players can find themselves in when attempting to access the security room deep inside the facility (no spoilers!!)[/p][/*][*][p]Resolving various and sporadic crashes that can be experienced throughout the game (thank you to everyone who sent us your crash reports!)[/p][/*][*][p]Making sure Chica does not abandon the Warehouse when trying to find our stealthiest players[/p][/*][*][p]Addressing checkpoint spawn behavior issues near the Big Top Prize wheel and other affected locations[/p][/*][*][p]Making sure players can't get stuck when trying to interact with the generator in the manager's office[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing some visual issues that can be triggered during the climatic confrontation with the Mimic[/p][/*][*][p]Making trash in the Doll Hospital easier to see so everyone is able to reliably collect as many as are needed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing a world state issue where players could become trapped behind a specific ball toss machine[/p][/*][/list][p][b]We're working as quickly as we can to resolve these community call outs and will have a patch ready for you soon.[/b] Thank you again for all your communication and patience while we continue to improve the game![/p]

tags.bug: Fixing the automatic entryway doors not opening at the beginning of the game
Fixing a soft lock players can find themselves in when attempting to access the security room deep inside the facility (no spoilers!!)
Resolving various and sporadic crashes that can be experienced throughout the game (thank you to everyone who sent us your crash reports!)
Making sure Chica does not abandon the Warehouse when trying to find our stealthiest players
Addressing checkpoint spawn behavior issues near the Big Top Prize wheel and other affected locations
Making sure players can't get stuck when trying to interact with the generator in the manager's office
Fixing some visual issues that can be triggered during the climatic confrontation with the Mimic
Making trash in the Doll Hospital easier to see so everyone is able to reliably collect as many as are needed
Fixing a world state issue where players could become trapped behind a specific ball toss machine
